governing_body: Regional Ministry of Universal Health and Public Health, Generalitat Valenciana, Spain
data_license: BIMCV Open Research License / Academic DUA required
access_requirements: Formal user registration on the BIMCV Portal (https://bimcv.cipf.es/)
Institutional affiliation and signed Data Use Agreement (DUA)
Authorized WebDAV / SFTP access credentials issued by BIMCV governance
Adherence to No-Blind-Download policy prohibiting automated unverified scraping

label_mapping_specifications.ground_truth_requirement: RT-PCR molecular laboratory confirmation linked to patient EHR encounter
inclusion_criteria: Documented positive RT-PCR SARS-CoV-2 test within +/- 7 days of imaging encounter
Full thoracic cage visible without severe motion truncation
exclusion_criteria: Non-planar imaging (axial CT slices or 3D volumes)
COVID-negative or unconfirmed clinical suspicion without RT-PCR confirmation
Severe hardware artifacts or corrupt pixel data

target_v5_ingestion_quota.expected_view_distribution: approx. 60% PA / 40% AP (consistent with hospital inpatient COVID cohorts)
target_v5_ingestion_quota.source_role: Provides independent second COVID source to decouple Existing_COVID-19
